governing_v555_authority.implication: A lawful SIG-004 relation route requires explicit V555 authority extension plus a governed channel/receiver closure. Merely changing the M2 contract check is insufficient.

relabel_control.diagnostic_value: Shows the contract-ID guard is the immediate runtime seam and M2 can enter its positive route-construction path after that guard.
relabel_control.reason: The HQ221 request uses locally generated hashes and locally supplied channel/receiver refs. M2 verifies expected IDs/versions and hash syntax, not that these values equal a current adopted SIG-004 authority/closure. Current ADP-002 does not authorize SIG-004.

additional_v555_hardening_observation.finding: M2 _auth accepts the expected authority/rule/shape IDs and versions plus any syntactically valid lowercase SHA-256; it does not compare those hashes to a bound current authority content hash.
additional_v555_hardening_observation.consequence: The HQ221 relabel control cannot be elevated into exact authority evidence. This is downstream V555 hardening/authority-binding work, not a defect in the demonstrated V554/V558 positive realization.
